title: Checking AMW irreducibility and normalization on the q=1 ring
question: Working again in the q=1 ring sector S_n(\lambda) with rates 1/x_j and 0\le t<1, the AMW result declares that the stationary measure of the multispecies exclusion chain is \pi(\eta)=F_{\eta}(x;1,t)/P_{\lambda}(x;1,t). To invoke this result we must know that (i) the CTMC is irreducible on S_n(\lambda) and (ii) the normalization constant P_{\lambda}(x;1,t)=\sum_{\nu\in S_n(\lambda)}F_{\nu}(x;1,t) is finite and strictly positive. Can someone provide a concrete argument for each point using only the t-PushTASEP update rules and basic properties of modified Macdonald polynomials?
